audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for forgiveness/release, Son of Humanity authority, Matthew call, table fellowship, mercy not sacrifice, fasting/bridegroom, new wine, hemorrhaging woman, ruler's daughter, blind men, mute man, compassion, harvest imagery.

verses.restored: Entering a boat, Jesus crossed over and came into his own city.

familiar.text: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

verses.restored: And look, they brought to him a paralyzed man lying on a mat. Seeing their trust, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, Take courage, child; your sins/misalignments are released.

familiar.text: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

verses.restored: And look, some of the scribes said among themselves, This one blasphemes.

familiar.text: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

verses.restored: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, Why do you think harmful things in your hearts?

familiar.text: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

verses.restored: For which is easier: to say, Your sins/misalignments are released, or to say, Rise and walk?

familiar.text: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

verses.restored: But so you may know that the Son of Humanity has authority on earth to release sins/misalignments, then he said to the paralyzed man, Rise, take up your mat, and go to your house.

familiar.text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

verses.restored: He rose and went to his house.

familiar.text: And he arose, and departed to his house.

verses.restored: When the crowds saw, they were afraid and glorified the Divine, who had given such authority to humans.

familiar.text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

verses.restored: Passing on from there, Jesus saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, Follow me. And he rose and followed him.

familiar.text: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

verses.restored: As he reclined at table in the house, look, many tax collectors and sinners came and reclined with Jesus and his disciples.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

verses.restored: When the Pharisees saw, they said to his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?

familiar.text: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

verses.restored: Hearing this, he said, Those who are strong have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.

familiar.text: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

verses.restored: Go and learn what this means: I desire mercy and not sacrifice. For I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners/misaligned ones.

familiar.text: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.restored: Then John's disciples came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?

familiar.text: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

verses.restored: Jesus said to them, Can the sons of the bridal chamber mourn while the bridegroom is with them? Days will come when the bridegroom is taken from them, and then they will fast.

familiar.text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

verses.restored: No one puts a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the patch pulls away from the garment, and a worse tear happens.

familiar.text: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

verses.restored: Nor do they put new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the skins burst, the wine pours out, and the skins are ruined. But they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

familiar.text: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

verses.restored: While he was saying these things, look, a ruler came, bowed before him, and said, My daughter has just died; but come lay your hand on her, and she will live.

familiar.text: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

verses.restored: Jesus rose and followed him, and so did his disciples.

familiar.text: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

verses.restored: And look, a woman suffering a flow of blood for twelve years came behind him and touched the fringe of his garment.

familiar.text: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

verses.restored: For she said within herself, If only I touch his garment, I will be saved/healed.

familiar.text: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

verses.restored: Jesus turned, saw her, and said, Take courage, daughter; your trust has saved/healed you. And the woman was healed from that hour.

familiar.text: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

verses.restored: When Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the flute players and the crowd making noise,

familiar.text: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

verses.restored: he said, Withdraw, for the girl has not died but sleeps. And they laughed at him.

familiar.text: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

verses.restored: When the crowd had been put outside, he went in, took her hand, and the girl rose.

familiar.text: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

verses.restored: This report went out into all that land.

familiar.text: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

verses.restored: As Jesus passed on from there, two blind men followed him, crying out, Have mercy on us, Son of David.

familiar.text: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.

verses.restored: When he entered the house, the blind men came to him, and Jesus said to them, Do you trust that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, Lord.

familiar.text: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

verses.restored: Then he touched their eyes, saying, Let it happen for you according to your trust.

familiar.text: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

verses.restored: Their eyes were opened. Jesus sternly warned them, saying, See that no one knows.

familiar.text: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

verses.restored: But they went out and spread his fame in that whole land.

familiar.text: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

verses.restored: As they were going out, look, they brought to him a mute man troubled by an unclean spirit.

familiar.text: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

verses.restored: When the spirit was cast out, the mute man spoke. The crowds marveled, saying, Never has anything like this appeared in Israel.

familiar.text: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

verses.restored: But the Pharisees said, By the ruler of the unclean spirits he casts out the spirits.

familiar.text: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

verses.restored: Jesus went around all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good message of the reign, and healing every disease and every weakness.

familiar.text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

verses.restored: Seeing the crowds, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and thrown down, like sheep without a shepherd.

familiar.text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

verses.restored: Then he said to his disciples, The harvest is great, but the workers are few.

familiar.text: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

verses.restored: Therefore ask the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest.

familiar.text: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
